coefficient.formula: K=(0.05 m / 1.4) * fx_pixels, CoC diameter in pixels

training.h2_overlap: arithmetic mean, active only inside M
training.gate_collapse: Report extrema; halt for exact whole-domain zero or one at two consecutive phase-two checks

schedule.encoder: frozen Depth Anything V2 Small, layers 2/5/8/11 zero-based
schedule.coordinates: window in native pixel-edge coordinates; level pixel center x+0.5 and align_corners=False

tear_retraining.selection: Minimize mean holdout weighted edge error and false-step tear rate; then weighted edge error and earliest step.

scheme_A.fitted_value: raw mu_b before front/back clipping; detach a and g for this term
scheme_A.objective: Sum of the gap, normal and boundary masked pixel means; rod contributes zero.
scheme_A.rho2_rear_residual: 1.5 * tanh(h1), independent of a and g
scheme_A.semantics: Single-surface rear targets use the v3 order constraint in gap, normal and boundary. The single-rear term omits rod pixels. The dual-surface term retains the v3 support.

selection.metric: Equal mean of the rod, gap, boundary and normal zone pixel means of 25.4 * abs(decoded rho - GT center rho), in px.
selection.boundary: For a boundary prediction at p, take the minimum error against valid ground truth at q in the 3x3 window about p.
selection.rod_gate: Holdout rod absolute decoded-error p50 <= 1.00 * OVG rho1 rod-error p50.
selection.fallback: Minimum rod p50, then earlier step if tied.

evaluation.success: G F2 and S2 each have paired median >= 0 dB and pooled PSNR >= B.
